Class EncryptedTransport

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.protection.EncryptedTransport
public final class EncryptedTransport extends Object
v1.0 transport layer for per-AU encrypted files. Writer pushes ciphertext bytes from the <channel>_segments compound onto the wire unmodified (the server never decrypts in transit, per docs/transport-spec.md §6.2). Reader materialises an encrypted .tio on the receiver side preserving ciphertext bytes verbatim.

Cross-language equivalents: Python ttio.transport.encrypted, Objective-C TTIOEncryptedTransport.

    • stampTransportWrappedDek

      public static void stampTransportWrappedDek(String ttioPath, byte[] wrappedDek, String kekAlgorithm, String providerName) throws IOException
      Stamp a wrapped DEK + KEK algorithm onto every run's signal_channels so writeEncryptedDataset(String, TransportWriter, String) emits it in the ProtectionMetadata packet.

      Used for envelope / PQC per-AU upload, where the per-run DEK is wrapped under the recipient's KEK (aes-256-gcm) or KEM public key (ml-kem-1024). All channels in a run share the DEK (v1.0 design), so the wrapper is stamped on each run's first channel -- the same attribute the writer reads.

      Cross-language equivalent: Python transport.encrypted.stamp_transport_wrapped_dek.

      Throws:
      IOException

    • readTransportWrappedDek

      public static EncryptedTransport.WrappedDek readTransportWrappedDek(String ttioPath, String providerName) throws IOException
      Return the wrapped DEK + KEK algorithm stamped on the first run's signal_channels, or an empty WrappedDek if none. The receiver unwraps the DEK with its KEK / KEM private key, then calls PerAUFile.decryptFile(String, byte[], String).

      Cross-language equivalent: Python transport.encrypted.read_transport_wrapped_dek.

      Throws:
      IOException
